topic: AI Ethics, Responsible AI, and Model Safety
learningObjectives: Identify common ethical risks in AI systems
Recognize sources of bias and unreliable model outputs
Apply basic responsible AI practices when designing AI applications

activities.title: Responsible AI Map
activities.instruction: Explore the major dimensions of responsible AI.

content.concept: Responsible AI considers areas such as fairness, transparency, privacy, safety, accountability, and reliability.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Reduce unjustified differences in how an AI system treats people or groups.
Make relevant information about an AI system's behavior and limitations understandable.
Protect personal and sensitive information throughout the AI lifecycle.
Reduce harmful, unsafe, or unintended behavior from the AI system.
Define who is responsible for system decisions, outcomes, and oversight.
Ensure the system performs consistently and handles errors appropriately.

activities.title: Find the Risk
activities.instruction: Select the potential AI risk shown in each scenario.

content.concept: AI systems can introduce risks through biased data, privacy issues, unsafe outputs, or inappropriate use.

activities.title: Bias Through the Pipeline
activities.instruction: Arrange where bias can enter an AI workflow.

content.concept: Bias can arise during data collection, labeling, preprocessing, modeling, evaluation, or deployment.

activities.title: Safety Architecture
activities.instruction: Build safeguards around an AI application.

content.concept: AI applications can use validation, access controls, monitoring, human review, and output safeguards to reduce risks.
